job.title: Product Designer (Associate)
job.description: Nexora Health is a Series-A health-tech startup in Hyderabad building a telemedicine platform for Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities. We need an Associate Product Designer who can translate fuzzy product requirements into clean, testable interfaces. You will collaborate closely with PMs and engineers and run fortnightly usability sessions. Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with design systems are non-negotiable. Prior experience in health or fintech UX is preferred but not mandatory.
